{{Quote|That lightsaber looks good on you. But comes with a price you know."<br />"Everything does.|Luke Skywalker and Kyle Katarn|<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent" />}}
This '''green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]''' was created by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]]. He passed it on to [[Morgan Katarn]], who in turn gave it to his son, [[Kyle Katarn]], who used it in his [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Yun]], [[Gorc]], [[Picaroon C. Boodle|Pic]], and [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]]. It was later destroyed by [[Boc Aseca]].

The lightsaber had a cylindrical hilt is primarily metallic silver in color with black accents and a copper colored section near the emitter. A flat 'spine' runs most of the length of one side of the hilt. A ring is attached to the pommel.

==History==
{{Quote|&hellip;the last is a lightsaber, that once belonged to a friend and great Jedi: Rahn. Use it well. Use it for good.|[[Morgan Katarn]]'s holorecording to [[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" />}}
At some point, Jedi Qu Rahn built a green-bladed lightsaber for himself. After meeting [[Morgan Katarn]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] around [[1 BBY/Legends|1BBY]], Rahn felt that Katarn's [[Kyle Katarn|son]], despite being having [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|training]], would eventually follow a different path. Rahn entrusted Katarn with his lightsaber and began using another lightsaber that once belonged to his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] instead.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent" /> Morgan kept the lightsaber hidden in his home, placing it inside the body of the family droid, [[WeeGee]]. In his holorecording, Morgan left the lightsaber to his son, [[Kyle Katarn]], urging him to use the lightsaber for good.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" />

The lightsaber remained hidden during the [[Subjugation of Sulon|raid on Sulon]] and Morgan Katarn's capture,<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> and even the homestead's ransacking by the [[Seven Dark Jedi]] and the [[Grave Tuskens]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] in their quest to learn the location of the [[Valley of the Jedi]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent" /> Kyle, on a mission to stop Jerec from using the power of the Valley, then came across the lightsaber after reactivating WeeGee and watching his father's holorecording.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" />

[[File:Kylekatarn_jasoncourt.jpg|thumb|right|Kyle Katarn wielding the lightsaber for the first time|251x251px]]

Kyle decided to test the weapon, using it along with his arsenal to fight his way out of the homestead and through the irrigation channels. Kyle carried it throughout his mission on Sulon, through [[Barons Hed]], and subsequently used it in his duel against the young Dark Jedi [[Yun]]. Katarn further used the lightsaber in his hunt for [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] on the ''[[Sulon Star]]'', and then used it once more against the Dark Jedi "brothers," [[Gorc]] and [[Picaroon C. Boodle|Pic]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" /> <br /> [[File:Kyle_katarn1.jpg|thumb|left|Katarn wielding the lightsaber, having just slain [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]]|267x267px]]

Katarn used the saber throughout his [[Mission to Ruusan|mission on Ruusan]], using it to defend himself in his duel against [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]]. Upon slaying Maw in anger after Maw taunted him over his father's death, Jerec prompted Kyle to strike down the captured [[Jan Ors]] with the saber and embrace the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. However, Kyle refused. Upon escaping Jerec, Kyle crashed the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'', and the saber was destroyed with a rock shortly thereafter by [[Boc Aseca]]. Upon [[Yun]]'s sacrifice, Kyle took up [[Yun's lightsaber]] for the remainder of the mission, until he constructed [[Kyle Katarn's third lightsaber|his own lightsaber]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" />
